current_production_path.exact_per_request_values: The run's per-request date windows, offsets and slug lists live in the production table request_attempts.params_json and were NOT exported for this bundle. Shapes and constant values below were read back from that table (grouped) on 2026-09-18 and match the deployed code.

scheduling.strategy: balanced_v1: 10 single-page slots per cycle, alternating active-jb / active-ats; slots 2 and 7 use discovery_v1, the other 8 use priority_v1
scheduling.partitions: Each (endpoint, profile, lane, date_created window) is a partition with its own persisted offset. Fresh lane: 1-hour windows ending at least 3 hours before now. Backfill lane: 24-hour windows walking backwards.
scheduling.partition_choice: priority_v1 picks the newest open window first; discovery_v1 the oldest; every 5th page of a source/profile prefers the backfill lane
scheduling.stop_per_slot: one page per slot; a partition is complete only when a page returns fewer rows than limit
scheduling.budget: run start command reserves 20 requests / 1,000 job credits per 24h; each page reserves limit=100 credits
